decisions: Known operations must be resolved through Roslyn symbols, not text-only method names.
Unsupported or unresolved invocations remain Unknown; the inherited conservative O(n) fallback is explicitly rejected.
Known operation mappings carry complexity, execution semantics, provenance, and diagnostic metadata.
LINQ deferred pipeline creation must not be charged as full enumeration until supported consumption is observed.
Initial scope prioritizes small BCL/LINQ subsets with verifiable provenance rather than full parity with inherited mappings.
BIG0001 is specified as Info and disabled by default; BIG100x diagnostics start conservatively and must minimize false positives.
constraints: Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not create ProjectReference, binary reference, local package dependency, or transitive dependency on inherited projects.
Do not copy the inherited BCL registry wholesale.
Do not implement call graph, interprocedural analysis, recursion, recurrence solving, Workspaces, CodeFix, memory complexity, parallel complexity, or probabilistic complexity in Phase 4.
Do not change BIG9000 unless a later explicit spec changes that contract.
Respect CancellationToken and keep analyzer hot paths deterministic, immutable, and free from I/O, network access, process execution, and reflection-heavy behavior.
validations: Phase 3 was verified from code and tests before creating the Phase 4 specification.
Release tests passed for the analyzer workspace before documentation edits.
knownPendingItems: Implement known-operation model and immutable registry.
Implement semantic resolver for BCL and LINQ mappings.
Add BIG0001 and BIG100x diagnostics only after descriptor/release/documentation updates and tests.
